name: Beagle
description: Beagles are cheerful, curious hounds with strong scenting abilities and friendly temperaments. They are great with families and enjoy active play.

careGuide.nutrition: Feed a balanced diet with high-quality protein. Monitor portions as Beagles can overeat. Use slow feeders if needed.
careGuide.grooming: Brush weekly and bathe every 4-6 weeks. Check ears regularly as floppy ears can trap moisture.
careGuide.exercise: Provide 60 minutes of daily exercise including walks and sniff games. Mental stimulation via scent work is ideal.
careGuide.health: Watch for ear infections, obesity, and intervertebral disc disease. Keep up with routine veterinary care.

name: Golden Retriever
description: Golden Retrievers are affectionate, intelligent, and eager-to-please family dogs. They excel in training and love outdoor activities and water.

careGuide.nutrition: Choose large-breed formulas with joint support. Portion meals twice daily and monitor weight.
careGuide.grooming: Brush 2-3 times weekly (daily during shedding). Bathe every 4-6 weeks and keep ears dry.
careGuide.exercise: Provide 60-90 minutes of activity—walks, swimming, and retrieving games. Include obedience for mental work.
careGuide.health: Monitor for hip/elbow dysplasia, skin allergies, ear infections, and certain cancers. Maintain regular vet care.
